title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m willing to believe he WAS blind but can see some things now is how I talk myself down
Where do you fall in that scale?
That theory has legs but I don’t think that guy is the messenger for it
Yeah, because he’s so fanatical about it
Oh, that’s why I texted you last night... a double whammy of Greg comments.... When I made that comment about unmasking me and it’s really you
I thought of how I could totally throw a troll reel into the water someday
By tweeting a tweet that is like so @Tigers from my account, with a Tigers link, or something
As if I forgot to change the account on Tweetdeck or hoot suite or something
Then delete it without saying something a few minutes later
You’d have to hope enough people saw it but I like that idea
